benchmark_model.halo: I = {x in H : for every positive integer n, |x| < 1/n}

native_results_to_reuse: fldidom: every field is an integral domain
ply1idom: univariate polynomials over an integral domain form an integral domain
fracfld: the field of fractions of an integral domain is a field
fracf1: canonical embedding into the field of fractions
coe1, coe1f, coe1sfi: coefficient map and finite support machinery
deg1nn0cl, deg1ldg: a nonzero polynomial degree is in NN0 and its leading coefficient is nonzero
<<<: generic infinitesimal relation for ordered structures

known_reference_route: R <=card I via r |-> r t
H ~~ R via coding rational functions by finite real data

required_before_blind_target_run: exact frozen set.mm snapshot and SHA-256
exact conservative HaloProof order/halo extension and SHA-256
exact target label and parsed target statement
verified reference certificate built outside the blind search condition
independent verifier agreement on the reference certificate
nontrivial admissible index excluding target leakage and direct target restatements

labels.hpcoe1map: polynomial coefficient vector maps NN0 into the coefficient carrier
labels.hpcoe1fsupp: polynomial coefficient vector has finite support

current_candidate.hpcoe1nzex: a nonzero polynomial has a nonzero coefficient, witnessed by its degree

foundation_obligations: DONE: instantiate P = Poly1(RRfld) and prove P is an integral domain
DONE: instantiate H = Frac(P) and prove H is a field
DONE: coefficient vectors map NN0 into the real coefficient carrier
DONE: coefficient vectors have finite support
CANDIDATE: prove every nonzero polynomial has a nonzero coefficient
prove the nonzero coefficient-index class has a least element
define eventual-sign positivity/order from the least-degree nonzero coefficients
prove the order is independent of fraction representatives
prove eventual-sign relation is a strict total order
prove order is compatible with field addition and multiplication
package H as an ordered field
identify embedded t, prove positivity and infinitesimality
define the exact two-sided halo I
prove r |-> r t is one-to-one from R into I
prove H is equipollent to R via finite coefficient data
derive I <=card R and finish I ~~ R by Schroeder-Bernstein

next_milestone.goal: Obtain the least nonzero coefficient exponent for every nonzero polynomial and define its sign near 0+
next_milestone.preferred_route: Use deg1nn0cl and deg1ldg for nonemptiness, then well-ordering of NN0 for the least index

search_architecture.shared_bank_policy: Only independently verified lemmas may enter the reusable bank
search_architecture.decomposition: verified lemma campaign rather than one monolithic proof search
search_architecture.settlement_compass_role: mesoscopic premise/territory prioritization, not an oracle for the next inference
search_architecture.conservative_fallback: A proof-covering unguided share must remain enabled
search_architecture.reflective_control: Level-2-style controller may adapt search allocation from observed search state; it may not assert theoremhood
search_architecture.persistence: Atomic SHA-256 checkpoints, complete frontier state, exact expansion accounting, deterministic replay
search_architecture.final_verification: Fresh-process independent verification of the exact frozen target certificate

notes: The rational-function benchmark is distinct from the separate ultrapower/nonprincipal-ultrafilter formalization in ATP/hyperreal.mm.
The reference-proof construction phase is route-informed by design. The later blind benchmark must seal the reference proof and route-derived leakage.
No timeout, empty frontier, crash, or budget exhaustion is evidence of falsity or independence.
